title: Ejusdem generis: general words following specific examples
shortTitle: Ejusdem generis: general words following specific examples
summary: This canon can limit general language following specific terms to the class suggested by those terms.
notes: Identify the listed examples, determine whether they form a coherent class, and ask whether the general phrase should carry that class forward. Katzmann includes the convention among familiar interpretive rules. Its application depends on context; identifying a possible class does not automatically override a contrary definition or clear structural signal. The supplied Katzmann section gives the rule as an example and does not itself supply a separate full case applying it.
